items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: What about, who's in the tapas? ... You have Edmund Fusher.

ctx.x: What about, who's in the tapas? I wanted to ask you that.

Well, you have Milton Baptiste, trumpet player. You have Edmund Fusher. And on the drums you have Joe Butler. Edmund Fusher is a trumpet player. Yeah, Edmund Fusher. Wallace Johnson, a bass player. Charlie Gasper, an alto player. George Johnson, an alto player. David Gray, I believe that's his last name, a tenor saxophone player. Julius Schick Snyder on the baritone side. It's more of a progressive side of jazz, moderate jazz. It's a type of music I play. This is like I say, this is what I'm trying to do is not…
But you have played rock and roll too, huh?
